text:
Rae: Hey team — doing a small desk refresh. Free/ask-only-if-you-want: a VARIDESK standing-desk converter (fits up to 48" desks, very solid), two leftover Caltrain monthly passes (May), and a 27" color-calibrated monitor I used for photo edits (Minor bezel scratch on top-left). Pick up SF office or I can drop at mailroom. First come, first served.

Tomas: I could use the Varidesk if it's compatible. How heavy is it? Need to know if I should bring help.

Rae: @Tomas it's about 25lbs assembled, pretty manageable but awkward. @Alex - Facilities offered to help move heavy stuff after 3pm.

Jules (they/them): Interested in a Caltrain pass if they're transferable? I'm commuting May->Jun and could use one.

Rae: @Jules the passes are physical Clipper transfers I got as backups. I'll hand them over, no fee. DM me for pickup or I can leave them at the front desk.

Alex - Facilities: If you leave the VARIDESK in storage B I can bring the hand truck and help move it to the main floor at 3:15. Recommend two people for lifting.

Tomas: I'll take the VARIDESK. Can meet 3:15 at storage B. Happy to coordinate moving with @Alex - Facilities.

Jules (they/them): I'll take one Caltrain pass, thanks @Rae. DMing now.

Rae: Monitor is still available — color profile included on a small USB stick. It's been kept in low-light studio; calibration report attached in the stick. If someone wants both monitor + Varidesk, priority to split so more folks can use things.

Tomas: I only need the Varidesk, but if the monitor's still around after moving I can swing back for it.

Alex - Facilities: Noted. @Rae please label items with a sticky note (name) and leave them in storage B. I'll lock the cabinet and put an access note on the storage door so only the takers get it. :wrench: 

caltrain-bot: Reminder set — "Jules pick up Caltrain pass from Rae" on 2026-05-01 10:00.

Rae: Summary: Varidesk -> @Tomas (pickup 3:15 storage B, @Alex assisting), Caltrain pass -> @Jules, monitor -> available (first to reply after 3:30). I'll update here if anything changes. Cheers! :sparkles:
